scope: Offline restricted-client shim and focused synthetic tests only; not deployment, native SDK initialization, runtime policy or operational approval.
environment: VERIFIED_ENV for the recorded isolated host synthetic test command only

direct_comparison.meaning: Expected difference, not command failure: only two helper functions and restricted-client cache-publication ordering changed; ordinary client and all other source unchanged.

verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider -q --tb=short tests/test_companion_s3_single_attempt.py tests/test_companion_probe_policy.py
verification.proof_type: Hash-checked captured SDK method ASTs with synthetic dependencies; actual application source loaded with stubbed clients/settings and blocked socket entrypoints. No real SDK client initialization or services.

shown: Captured Endpoint._send_request routes replay decisions through self._needs_retry; captured _needs_retry dispatches the event that can call the region handler and nested HeadBucket.
Unmodified captured-method control reproduces two sends plus one nested HeadBucket; patched cases perform one send with no retry-event dispatch, nested HeadBucket or retry sleep.
301/302/307, 400 PermanentRedirect, 500, 503 and 200 error-shaped responses are exercised, along with success and transport-exception identity.

Guard is installed on the newly constructed restricted endpoint instance, with callable check and exact identity readback before publishing _restricted_s3. No class/global SDK patch or ordinary-client change.

Unsupported, read-only or ignored hook installation refuses with fixed RuntimeError text; candidate close is best-effort; failed initialization does not publish either cache or fall back to the ordinary client.
Restricted endpoint allowlisting and separate ordinary-client behavior remain covered by the focused existing suite.
risks_and_limits: Private _endpoint._needs_retry hook is version-specific. Callable/readback checks alone do not prove an arbitrary future SDK still dispatches through that hook.

Synthetic captured-method tests establish the reviewed decision boundary, not full SDK construction, transport, credential resolution, whole startup/import behavior, live endpoint health or a dashboard explanation result.
Failure close is best-effort, not a guarantee that an incompatible client closes successfully.
Old captured source, manifests, prepared images and resources were not changed. Their old source hash does not bind the repaired main.py; this receipt does not update or authorize them.
No native Docker, build, service, database, credential, lifecycle or runtime-query operations were performed by this review. No full-suite result is claimed.
Runtime/explanation acceptance remains INCOMPLETE; startup/cutover remains UNAUTHORIZED.
